name: Continue
description: Initial part of a request received, client should continue with request.

name: Switching Protocols
description: Server agreed to switch protocols according to Upgrade header.

name: Processing
description: Server has received and is processing the request, but no response is available yet.

name: Early Hints
description: Returns headers before rest of response, allowing client to preload resources.

name: OK
description: Standard response for successful HTTP requests.

name: Created
description: Request fulfilled, resulting in the creation of a new resource.

name: Accepted
description: Request accepted for processing, but processing has not been completed.

name: No Content
description: Server successfully processed request, but is not returning any content.

name: Partial Content
description: Server is delivering only part of resource due to Range header sent by client.

name: Moved Permanently
description: Target resource has been assigned a new permanent URI.

name: Found
description: Target resource resides temporarily under a different URI.

name: See Other
description: Response can be found under another URI using the GET method.

name: Not Modified
description: Indicates resource has not been modified since version specified in If-Modified-Since.

name: Temporary Redirect
description: Target resource resides temporarily under different URI; method must not change.

name: Permanent Redirect
description: Target resource has been assigned new permanent URI; method must not change.

name: Bad Request
description: Server cannot process request due to client error or malformed syntax.

name: Unauthorized
description: Authentication is required and has failed or has not yet been provided.

name: Payment Required
description: Reserved for digital payment systems; occasionally used for quota paywalls.

name: Forbidden
description: Server understood request but refuses to authorize it; credentials lack permissions.

name: Not Found
description: Server cannot find the requested resource.

name: Method Not Allowed
description: HTTP method is known by server but not supported for target resource.

name: Request Timeout
description: Server timed out waiting for client request.

name: Conflict
description: Request conflicts with current state of target resource (e.g., edit conflict).

name: Gone
description: Target resource is no longer available at origin server and no forwarding address is known.

name: Payload Too Large
description: Request entity is larger than limits defined by server.

name: Unsupported Media Type
description: Payload format is in unsupported format for requested endpoint.

name: I'm a teapot
description: April Fools joke RFC 2324; returned when attempting to brew coffee on a teapot.

name: Unprocessable Entity
description: Request syntax was well-formed, but semantic instructions could not be followed.

name: Too Many Requests
description: User has sent too many requests in a given amount of time (rate limited).

name: Internal Server Error
description: Generic error message when an unexpected condition was encountered on server.

name: Not Implemented
description: Server does not recognize request method, or lacks ability to fulfil it.

name: Bad Gateway
description: Server acting as gateway/proxy received invalid response from inbound server.

name: Service Unavailable
description: Server is currently unable to handle request due to temporary overload/maintenance.

name: Gateway Timeout
description: Server acting as gateway/proxy did not receive timely response from upstream server.

name: HTTP Version Not Supported
description: Server does not support HTTP protocol version used in request.
